snippet.title: Anvil Launch Trailer | Halo Infinite
snippet.description:
Welcome to Anvil, Spartan. 

Our next Operation is live until July 30 and comes with a free 20 tier Operation pass with new Sangheili-themed customizations to unlock. 

Play BTB: Sentry Defense on six maps, including the new BTB map Command and earn exclusive items by progressing your Pass.  

Read more about Anvil here: http://aka.ms/AnvilLaunch 

#halo #haloinfinite #haloanvil
